title: Air Force Manned Orbiting Laboratory, cancelled 1969

tellings.quote: And then in June of 1969, exactly 1 month before the Apollo mission reached the moon for the first time, the man orbiting laboratory was cancelled.

plain: The US Air Force once planned a Manned Orbiting Laboratory, a small military space station with a crew, and it was cancelled in June 1969, exactly one month before the Apollo mission first landed on the Moon. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about a hacker who says he found a secret NASA space program. He points to the timing as a hint that the military space effort may not simply have ended.
